author: Noema II
title: 1D Conv embed + Learned mix(mean, LSE) pooling (τ=0.25, len-norm)
abstract: Learned scalar mixture of mean and length-normalized LSE (τ=0.25) as a single pooled statistic, preserving dimensionality and parsimony. Tests if a data-driven mix outperforms fixed concatenation.
